title: COACHMEN INDUSTRIES, INC.: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:PIPE:FILLER:NECK (242 affected)

title: Ford Motor Company: TIRES (46 affected)
summary: THE INVOLVED VEHICLES DO NOT CONFORM TO FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 120, "TIRE SELECTION AND RIMS FOR MOTOR VEHICLES OTHER THAN PASSENGER CARS". THESE LIGHT TRUCKS WERE INCORRECTLY CLASSIFIED AS PASSENGER VEHICLES AND WERE EQUIPPED WITH LOAD RANGE "A" INSTEAD OF LOAD RANGE "B" TIRES. THIS COULD LEAD TO INADVERTENT VEHICLE OVERLOADING.

title: Goodyear Tire & Rubber Company: TIRES:PLY (600 affected)

title: WHITE MOTOR CORPORATION: STEERING:COLUMN SHAFT UPPER (209 affected)

title: BMW of North America, LLC: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES (500 affected)

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL (3,085 affected)

title: Ferrari North America, Inc.: SUSPENSION:SINGLE AXLE:REAR:CONTROL ARM (507 affected)
summary: THE INNER BUSHINGS OF THE ARTICULATED JOINTS OF THE REAR SUSPENSION MAY RUST DUE TO ADVERSE ENVIRONMENTAL CONDITIONS. RUST MAY CAUSE THE SUSPENSION TO JAM.

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:IGNITION:OTHER PART (33,552 affected)

title: BUDD COMPANY: BRAKES:INTERCONNECTING ASSEMBLY (WIRING:CONNECTING (12 affected)
summary: THE INVOLVED VEHICLES DO NOT CONFORM TO FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 121, "AIR BRAKE SYSTEMS". THERE IS AN INCOMPLETE CONNECTION OF THE ANTI-SKID COMPUTER POWER CIRCUIT TO THE STOPLIGHT CIRCUIT OF THE VEHICLE. THUS THE ANTI-SKID COMPUTER WILL NOT TO FUNCTION AND WHEEL LOCK-UP MAY OCCUR UNDER SEVERE BRAKING CONDITIONS.

title: CHAMPION HOME BLDR. CO.: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:BATTERY:CARRIER:HOLD DWN (145 affected)

title: DUNLOP TIRE CORPORATION: TIRES:MARKINGS (1,074 affected)
